entities.summary: Aleksandr Pavlovich Lapin is a Russian retired colonel general who last served as commander of the restored Leningrad Military District from 2024 to 2025. He was previously the chief of staff and first deputy commander-in-chief of the Russian Ground Forces from 2023 to 2024, and commander of the Central Military District from 2017 to 2022. Lapin was promoted to the rank of colonel general in 2019.
